title: 2.4.30 Triangle of Stars
description: Use a nested loop to print a triangle of stars, one row at a time, where the inner loop's limit depends on the outer loop's counter. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: book 2.4 — Try It Now 2.4 + Concepts in Practice 'Counting nested work'

steps.title: Outer loop — the rows
steps.instructions: Write an outer for loop with counter row running from 1 to 5.

steps.title: Inner loop — bound by row, not a fixed number
steps.instructions: Inside the outer loop, declare an empty string called line. Write an inner for loop with counter star that runs from 1 up to row (not a fixed number like 5) — that is what makes each row longer than the last. Append a "*" to line on every inner pass.

steps.title: Print the row
steps.instructions: After the inner loop closes, log line. You should see 1 star on the first line, up to 5 stars on the last.
